listing.name: Prince of Persia (DOS) (SDLPoP)
listing.summary: Conditional Windows prepared-player route: attach only an already permitted working native SDLPoP copy. Official external package contents, accepted original/mod DAT set and asset permissions remain unresolved for fresh managed admission; no unsupported external original EXE/ROM requirement is added. Core offers nonowning registration/Play while upstream owns setup, actual state roots and replacement.

steps.title: Use only an already permitted working native copy
steps.instruction: Use a complete SDLPoP Windows copy that you are already permitted to use, with its actual working data/libraries/resources. Select the modern native prince.exe, not the same-named DOS original, a download helper or installer. Selected current source enters pop_main in the game process, but does not certify an external binary. Official README links desktop builds externally; no selected GitHub release does not mean there is no distribution.

steps.title: Keep the unresolved asset condition explicit
steps.instruction: Fresh managed-package admission remains unavailable while exact official distribution contents, accepted original/mod DAT set and applicable original asset permissions are unresolved. README supports original/mod DAT and MIDISND data but does not establish a separate player-owned original EXE or ROM requirement; do not invent one. The engine GPL/disassembly classification does not grant proprietary asset rights. This conditional existing-copy route neither downloads assets nor resolves that open permission/data question.

steps.title: Keep the creating working directory and options
steps.instruction: Complete upstream preparation and a normal start/quit before registration. Select the actual prepared working directory and established supported literal arguments/mod choices. Keep SDLPoP.ini and actual resource/levelset setup; do not substitute a replay-validator/headless/helper invocation for the normal player. Review exact intent/consent and choose Play separately. No Core environment injection or forced profile migration is supplied.

steps.title: Preserve all actual save, mod and replay roots
steps.instruction: On Windows normal PRINCE.SAV/QUICKSAVE.SAV/PRINCE.HOF writes can use the actual working directory. Existing SDLPOP_SAVE_PATH redirects save/HOF output, including a levelset subdirectory; without it a custom levelset can use its actual mod_data_path. Preserve all those roots, full runtime/DAT/MIDISND/mod data, SDLPoP.ini, configured replays_folder and recordings, legacy and unknown files. Keep the old creating runtime/data/config tuple before updates; no save/replay/mod compatibility or isolated profile is certified.

steps.title: Keep replacement and removal ownership clear
steps.instruction: Close all real instances before external file changes. Upstream/player owns preparation, runtime replacement, profile writes and any migration/recovery. Preserve the old creating copy and every actual data root, finish deliberate replacement upstream and review/relink the changed player before the next Play. Core observes only its separately consented selected process, not an exclusive instance family or sandbox, and does not adopt unrelated helpers/successors. Registration-only removal preserves all external files. No Core-managed acquisition/setup/update/backup/rollback/migration/deletion is offered by this route.

warnings: This guide adds no Supported promotion, original/component permission, acquired-source-to-binary or private-output certificate. Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use.
Source/API and inert native probes are distinct from actual game/save/mod/network, installed Desktop, physical/human, other-platform or protected acceptance. No such new observation is claimed.
Keep complete actual external runtime and player-data roots recoverable before upstream changes; another player folder does not guarantee independent shared state.
